Students examine theoretical and experimental issues in speech production and comprehension, language impairments, the relationship between thought and language, and the evolution and acquisition of language. analysis: The closest response combines rhetorical argument and public speaking with stylistics, film/media analysis, social context, qualitative observation and quantitative research. Style & Meaning includes dialogue and turn-taking, and literature and documentary courses bring distinct textual and visual methods. Environmental media and advanced persuasion include evidence-backed sustainability communication. GOSHIST312 contributes question formation, critical source use and a substantial historical paper through its official description. The workplace and health plan connects leadership, negotiation, organizational psychology, inclusion and consumer communication with health consultation, shared decision-making, evidence synthesis and language processing. Psycholinguistics and the prior brain and behavior course can run in the first year, allowing later methods and psychology. Intercultural communication is supported across social theory, cross-cultural negotiation and culturally competent health care rather than a standalone specialist module. The digital plan keeps rhetorical and media analysis at the center and uses programming, text data, learning and neural language models to examine digitally mediated communication. AI ethics supplies fairness, privacy and human agency; media history and digital strategy add technological and institutional context. Introductory rhetoric and Media Archaeology replace Optimization Methods and Organizational Psychology in this plan. This strengthens its communication focus while allowing Deep Learning in the last semester, after Mathematical Methods and Machine Learning. Its courses offer perspectives on human–AI interaction and digital communication, with no dedicated human–computer interaction design sequence. Groningen retains dedicated language, communication intervention design, case study and thesis components. Nine aligned pairs reflect specific shared topics or methods; broader links sit in separate rows. The optional UCR 15 EC research element is outside all schedules and distinct from the compulsory Groningen 10 EC thesis and seminar.

alignment.rationale: Both study how arguments and persuasive choices shape a message. UCR focuses on rhetoric, public speaking and written argument.
Both examine how language works in interaction. UCR studies turn-taking and dialogue within a broader course on stylistics.
Both address cognitive aspects of language. UCR studies reading and comprehension alongside spoken language and language disorders.
Both study how the material form of a medium shapes communication. UCR traces the technologies and artifacts of media history.
Groningen studies social-media discourse and platform features. UCR examines storytelling and representation across older and newer media.
Groningen studies communication and societal change. UCR courses explore specific examples such as climate communication and racial representation.
Both examine communication in organizations. UCR focuses on leadership, storytelling and persuasion.
Both examine communication in health care. UCR studies consultation and shared decisions within a wider health psychology course.
Groningen has a dedicated intercultural communication course. UCR studies culture and identity across sociology, rhetoric and leadership.
Groningen studies language in context. UCR approaches context through stylistics and social theory.
Both develop academic skills. UCR includes source evaluation, research questions and academic writing.
Both use qualitative research to investigate social meaning. UCR covers interviews, observation and interpretation across a range of social questions.
Both develop statistical analysis. UCR combines statistics with experimental methods and examples from psychology.
Groningen applies quantitative methods specifically to communication. UCR applies these methods in psychology and market research.
Groningen has a dedicated design and evaluation course for communication. UCR offers broader study in research design and measurement.
Groningen’s faculty elective links AI with digital society. UCR explores AI ethics and technical AI methods in separate courses.
Groningen continues its faculty-wide AI theme through a project course. UCR offers separate work in AI ethics, media and data.
Groningen reserves 30 EC for an approved minor.
Groningen studies literacy as a social practice in a dedicated course.
Groningen requires a 10 EC thesis and research seminar. UCR’s optional research element sits outside its degree schedule.
Groningen has a dedicated 10 EC communication case study.
